sk.predhovor: Damián Cehlárik je dizajnér, kurátor a pedagóg z Bratislavy. Pracuje so špekulatívnym a kritickým dizajnom ako praktik aj ako učiteľ a skúma, ako sa v strednej a východnej Európe stretávajú mesto, bývanie a to, čo je viac než ľudské. Projekty svojho ateliéru Damian Works nepublikuje ako galériu, ale ako texty.

en.predhovor: Damián Cehlárik is a designer, curator and educator based in Bratislava. He works with speculative and critical design as a practitioner and as a teacher, looking at how the city, housing and the more than human meet in Central and Eastern Europe. He does not publish the projects of his studio Damian Works as a gallery, but as texts.
